x: Mr. Ernest Neville and the many others who wrote: one such from Arthur Beaumont, M.E.F., dated 27th March, says, "Thanks for Xmas Card, arrived today."

Further tributes were then paid to Stan by Alf McSweeney whose club promoted the race in which Stan set the new records, by Ernest Neville who also presented to Stan the Fowler Dixon Style award which he won in the A.A.A.

In the absence of the holder Harold King,Bob McMullen won the club"10" walk in 82:24. Nearly 100 members,friends and visitors were present at the Club dinner amongst whom were W.J.Pepper, J.Binks, E.H.Neville, W.F.May, E.H.Collden, W.C.Jewell,and W.J.Palmer.
… this were augmented by the auction of a beautiful white Teddy Bear which was generously given by that grand gentleman, Ernest Neville.…
